description:
The TailwindTraders backlog is disorganized. Several User Stories are nested under the wrong Features, and some are orphaned (no parent). 

Your task is to reorganize the backlog by reparenting the stories to the correct Features based on their functionality:

1. Review the hierarchy in the Backlog view.
2. Move 'Implement full-text product search' and 'Add search filters by category and price' to the 'Search & Discovery' Feature.
3. Move 'Password reset via email' and 'User profile editing page' to the 'User Account Management' Feature.
4. Move 'Apply discount codes at checkout' and 'One-click purchase for saved payment methods' to the 'Shopping Cart & Checkout' Feature.
5. Link the orphaned stories 'Search autocomplete suggestions' (to Search) and 'Guest checkout without account creation' (to Shopping Cart) to their respective parents.

All changes must be saved.

Shopping Cart & Checkout: One-click purchase for saved payment methods
Search & Discovery: Add search filters by category and price
